_note: Seller/buyer lines are SYNTHETIC, written for the demo. Everything the bot says comes from the context file and the policy layer.

245234426.story: PT More Enterprises (Indore). VANI fixed a meeting on 18 Sep and the seller declined paid plans; a Bhopal buyer's enquiry from 1 Oct is still unanswered. On the call the seller is driving and asks for WhatsApp; the next WhatsApp message resumes exactly there.

lines: Haan ji, bol raha hoon. Meeting ho gayi thi, executive aaye the.
Abhi gaadi chala raha hoon, WhatsApp pe bhej do.
Free size heel protector 45 rupees per pair, MOQ 100 pair

93557756.story: Visionary Style Enterprise (Surat). VANI called 21 times; on 18 Sep the seller asked IndiaMART to stop calling and said an executive had already visited. A Surat buyer has been waiting since 1 Oct. VANI's outbound call is blocked by policy; when the seller writes in on WhatsApp, VANI acknowledges the request and goes straight to the waiting buyer.

lines: Small quantity ke liye 5 piece ka 1450 rupees, courier extra

272316904.story: Inde Electricals (Ahmedabad), paid CATALOG seller who buys leads. A 30 Sep enquiry for a brazing rod is unanswered. On the call the seller gives the rate and asks for a WhatsApp summary; WhatsApp picks up the call instead of starting over.

lines: Haan ji. Rahul ji se baat ho gayi thi, plan bhi le liya hai. Kaunsi enquiry?
Harris rod 1850 rupees per kg, MOQ 5 kg. Baaki ka summary WhatsApp pe bhej dena.

120622712.story: Buyer Ani (Kanpur). A seller asked them a question they never answered, and another enquiry is still waiting on a seller. The call picks up the seller's question; the buyer asks for suppliers on WhatsApp and the chat resumes there.

lines: Baaki suppliers ki list WhatsApp pe bhej dena
